d: Nvidia’s reported leadership turmoil has sparked a Silicon Valley campaign to bring Jensen Huang back, with Elon Musk and other influential figures reportedly backing his return. But allegations involving an executive linked to China, questions over advanced AI chip exports, and growing scrutiny from Washington have turned the controversy into a national security flashpoint. As Donald Trump weighs in and Nvidia faces questions about its leadership and business relationships, one bigger issue emerges: has the world’s most valuable AI chipmaker become too dependent on one man?
